chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn Muʿāwiyah, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jabalah, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, from Zurārah, who said:
I heard Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام saying: “Indeed, for al-Qāʾim عليه السلام there shall be a ghaybah (Occultation) before he rises.”
I said: “And why?” He عليه السلام said: “Because he fears,” and he gestured with his hand toward his belly, meaning killing.

key_terms.الْقَائِمِ: al-Qāʾim, the Imam who will rise
key_terms.غَيْبَةً: occultation or absence from public view
key_terms.يَقُومَ: to rise or begin his mission openly

ai.seo_question: Why will al-Qāʾim عليه السلام enter ghaybah before his rise?
ai.summary: This hadith states that al-Qāʾim عليه السلام will have a ghaybah (Occultation) before his rise. It explains that the reason for this occultation is fear of being killed, indicating a divinely significant period preceding his public appearance.
